title: Malformed values and currency mismatches bypass sandbox risk ceilings
evidence: audit_v2/phase2c/results/stress_checks.json: risk_nan_value, risk_negative_value, risk_wrong_currency, and risk_missing_currency all returned EXECUTED instead of DENIED.
impact: A state-changing scenario can execute with NaN, negative, missing/wrong currency, or other malformed economic context while still receiving an ALLOW decision and receipt.
recommended_fix: Validate finite non-negative numeric values and expected currency before risk, delegation, quote creation, and policy evaluation. Reject non-finite numbers and require currency when a ceiling or grant currency exists.

title: Idempotency claim is non-atomic under concurrent same-key execution
evidence: audit_v2/phase2c/results/stress_checks.json: concurrent_same_key_single_side_effect reported commit_count=8 and resource_version=9 for 8 simultaneous runs sharing one idempotency key.
impact: Two or more workers can observe no existing record, all call the execution adapter, and produce duplicate side effects before any record is stored.
recommended_fix: Reserve the idempotency key atomically before commit, store an in-progress state under a lock or durable compare-and-set, and ensure concurrent duplicates wait/replay rather than invoking the adapter.

title: Dry-run path can mutate adapter state during prepare or preview
evidence: audit_v2/phase2c/results/stress_checks.json: dry_run_preview_prepare_side_effect_trap returned WOULD_ALLOW while adapter snapshot changed from version 1 to version 3.
impact: A dry-run can be reported as non-executing even though the adapter performed state changes before the dry-run branch returned.
recommended_fix: Separate dry-run preview from mutating adapter preparation, require adapters to expose a non-mutating preview contract, and snapshot/fail if dry-run changes adapter-visible state.
